content:
The map is clear: (2,7) is '@', surrounded by walkable tiles. Yet movement is blocked in all directions.

This is a genuine engine issue where my body can't move. But wait — let me reconsider the "blocked" semantics. When I held W with until blockedMs:500, it said "interrupted: blocked". Maybe "blocked" means the game detected I'm pressing into a wall. But the map says walkable.

Unless... the '@' and 'P' are drawn but the actual collision treats the notice board as occupying a 3x3 or the whole area. 

Let me try the ONE thing I haven't: maybe movement works but only when I'm NOT facing a wall, and the game requires me to move in a direction where the tile is truly free. All 4 reported blocked. 

Let me try pressing KeyE toward the player (right) — maybe the player is a "door" or interactable that lets me pass.
